desc: With a heritage of accuracy and reliabable performance on every continent, a Winchester Model 70 Super Grade is on the wish list of savvy hunters. In addition to their performance, these rifles are also highly regarded for their excellent fit and finish, polished, deeply-blued steel, and finely checkered stocks with a shadowline cheekpiece. These features, and more, define the timeless grace and elegance of the Model 70 Super Grade AAA Claro. Claro is a beautiful specimen of walnut with dark brown coloration highlighted by dark mineral streaks. This wood is especially suited for a fine rifle with a history of excellence like the Super Grade. The expertly carved stock is accented with sharp checkering in a traditional fleur di lis pattern and finished with a black end cap, steel grip cap, and inletted swivel studs. The barreled action is finished with a rich, gloss blued finish that complements the grain of the claro. One-piece steel bottom metal and a cross bolt add extra rigidity to the Super Grade’s chassis for improved accuracy. The shadowline cheekpiece is beautifully functional, placing your eye in perfect alignment with the scope.
